ParquetNeo
Table of Contents

Namespace ParquetNeo.Metadata

Classes

ColumnChunk

Location and metadata of one column chunk (thrift ColumnChunk). Encryption fields are skipped.

ColumnIndex

The smallest and largest value of every data page of a column chunk, and how many are null (thrift ColumnIndex); entry i of each list is for the page at i in the OffsetIndex. The bounds are encoded as the statistics of the column are.

ColumnMetaData

Metadata of one column chunk (thrift ColumnMetaData). Geospatial statistics are not read yet.

FileMetaData

The Parquet footer (thrift FileMetaData). Unknown fields, including the extension field 32767, are skipped when reading; encryption fields are not supported yet.

KeyValue
LogicalType

A logical type annotation (thrift LogicalType union). Only the parameters relevant to Kind are meaningful.

OffsetIndex

The positions of the data pages of a column chunk (thrift OffsetIndex), so that a reader can go to a page without reading the ones before it.

PageEncodingStats

How many pages of a type used an encoding (thrift PageEncodingStats).

PageLocation

Where a data page of a column chunk is, and which row it starts with (thrift PageLocation).

RowGroup
SchemaElement

One node of the flattened, depth-first schema tree (thrift SchemaElement).

SizeStatistics

Size statistics of a column chunk (thrift SizeStatistics).

SortingColumn

A column a row group is sorted by (thrift SortingColumn).

Statistics

Column statistics for a page or column chunk (thrift Statistics).
